summary: SSE live push. Daemon: GET /events (text/event-stream, keepalive) + notifyChange() broadcast called on mutations (overlay status/edge/knowledge, agent start/done). graph.html + inline.html subscribe via EventSource(BASE+'/events') → instant refresh; slow poll (2-3s) kept as fallback. Verified the stream emits 'data: changed' on a status change. Note for integrators: /events is unauthenticated (read-class).
